title: Flow
subtitle: Automations across every zerosoft app and any service with an API.

list.title: Your flows
list.emptyHint: Start from scratch or pick a template below.
list.name: Name
list.adminOnly: Only workspace admins and owners can create or edit flows.

templates.title: Templates
templates.subtitle: Ready-made flows. Use one and adjust the details.

bookingToTrack.name: New Cal booking → Track task
bookingToTrack.desc: Every new booking creates an issue to prepare the meeting.

linkMilestone.name: Link clicked 100 times → email me
linkMilestone.desc: Get an email the moment a short link hits 100 clicks.

webhookToContact.name: Webhook → CRM contact
webhookToContact.desc: Any form or service that can POST JSON creates a contact.

dealsDigest.name: Daily digest of new deals
dealsDigest.desc: Every morning, an email with the deals created in the last 24 hours.

chatSummaryToSlack.name: Chat message → AI summary to Slack
chatSummaryToSlack.desc: Summarizes each incoming message with AI and posts it to a Slack webhook.

leadToCrmSlack.name: Form lead → CRM + Slack
leadToCrmSlack.desc: Each form submission becomes a contact and a message in your sales channel.

bookingToSheets.name: New booking → Google Sheets row
bookingToSheets.desc: Logs every Cal booking as a row: date, name, email and event.

dealWonToStripe.name: Deal won → Stripe customer
dealWonToStripe.desc: Creates the customer in Stripe as soon as a deal is marked won.

chatToTrack.name: Chat bug report → Track issue
chatToTrack.desc: AI flags chat messages that report a bug and opens a high-priority issue.

dailyDigestEmail.name: Weekday digest email
dailyDigestEmail.desc: Every weekday at 8:00, an AI summary of new deals sent from your Gmail.

robotToSheets.name: Robot data → Google Sheets
robotToSheets.desc: Appends what a robot extracts (like a daily price) to a sheet.

stripePaymentToSlack.name: Stripe payment → Slack
stripePaymentToSlack.desc: Posts each successful payment to Slack. Verified with the Stripe signature.

issueToDiscord.name: Urgent issue → Discord
issueToDiscord.desc: Sends urgent Track issues to a Discord channel.

formToTelegram.name: Form submission → Telegram
formToTelegram.desc: Get every form submission on Telegram.

bookingToNotion.name: Booking → Notion meeting notes
bookingToNotion.desc: Creates a page in a Notion database for each new booking.

webhookAgentReply.name: Webhook question → agent → Slack
webhookAgentReply.desc: An agent answers questions sent to a webhook and posts the answer to Slack.

editor.selectNode: Select a node to configure it. Drag nodes from the left or click them to add.
editor.deleteFlowConfirm: Delete this flow and all its runs? This can't be undone.
editor.noVariables: 0 variables. Connect this node to earlier ones, or run a test to see real data.
editor.webhookSaveFirst: Save the flow to get the URL.
editor.webhookHint: POST JSON or a form to this URL. Treat it as a secret. Use '{{trigger.body}}', '{{trigger.query}}' and '{{trigger.headers}}'.
editor.testInputHint: This JSON becomes '{{trigger}}'. Actions run for real (emails, records, HTTP requests).
editor.canvasHint: Add nodes from the left. Connect them by dragging from an output to the next node.
editor.templateHelp: Use '{{trigger.x}}' for trigger data and '{{nodes.<id>.output.x}}' for the output of an earlier node. Filters: json, join, lines, map:field, default:value, upper, lower, length.
editor.errorFlowHint: Runs another flow when a run fails. It receives '{{trigger.flow}}', '{{trigger.run.error}}' and '{{trigger.failedNode}}'.
editor.cronHelp: minute hour day month weekday. Example: 0 9 * * 1-5 = weekdays at 9:00.
editor.codeUnavailable: Code runs in an isolated Vercel Sandbox. It isn't available on this server: set FLOW_CODE_RUNNER=sandbox with Vercel credentials to enable it. Until then the node fails with code_unavailable.
editor.mergeHint: Waits until every connected node has run, then runs once. Use the key '...' to copy all fields of an object.
editor.scheduleGranularity: On zerosoft cloud the scheduler checks once an hour, so runs can start up to an hour late. Self-hosted, it follows your cron for /api/cron/tick.
editor.stripeHint: Save the flow, copy the webhook URL into Stripe (Developers → Webhooks) and save its signing secret in the credential. Unsigned requests are rejected.

trigger_event.title: App event
trigger_event.desc: Runs when something happens in zerosoft: a booking, a click, a new contact, an issue, a chat message…

trigger_webhook.title: Incoming webhook
trigger_webhook.desc: Runs when a service POSTs to this flow's secret URL.

trigger_schedule.title: Schedule
trigger_schedule.desc: Runs every N minutes or hours, daily at a time, or on a cron expression, in your time zone.

trigger_manual.title: Manual
trigger_manual.desc: Runs only from the Test run button, with the JSON you provide.

logic_if.title: If
logic_if.desc: Splits the flow in two: true and false.

logic_switch.title: Switch
logic_switch.desc: Picks a branch by comparing a value to a list of cases.

logic_filter.title: Filter
logic_filter.desc: Continues only if the conditions match. Otherwise the branch stops.

logic_loop.title: Loop
logic_loop.desc: Runs the item branch once per element of a list, in order. Then continues through done.

data_set.title: Set fields
data_set.desc: Builds an object with new fields from templates.

data_json_parse.title: Parse JSON
data_json_parse.desc: Turns JSON text into data you can use in later nodes.

action_http.title: HTTP request
action_http.desc: Calls any API. Public HTTPS hosts only.

app_crm_contact.title: CRM: create contact
app_crm_contact.desc: Creates a contact (or returns the existing one with the same email).

app_crm_sequence.title: CRM: enroll in sequence
app_crm_sequence.desc: Enrolls the contact with this email in a sales sequence. Emails go out from the contact owner's Gmail.

app_crm_deals.title: CRM: recent deals
app_crm_deals.desc: Lists deals created in the last N hours.

app_track_issue.title: Track: create issue
app_track_issue.desc: Creates an issue in a Track project of this workspace.

app_chat_message.title: Chat: send message
app_chat_message.desc: Replies in a Chat conversation as the bot.

app_docs_page.title: Docs: create page
app_docs_page.desc: Creates a Docs page. Blank lines separate paragraphs.

app_robot_run.title: Robots: run robot
app_robot_run.desc: Runs a browser robot with these inputs and waits for its extracted data (up to the robot's timeout).

ai_text.title: AI: generate text
ai_text.desc: Writes, summarizes or classifies text with AI. Counts toward your AI quota.

trigger_stripe.title: Stripe event
trigger_stripe.desc: Runs when Stripe sends an event to this flow's URL. The signature is verified with the credential's webhook secret.

logic_run_flow.title: Run flow
logic_run_flow.desc: Runs another flow with these inputs and waits for it. Its node outputs are in '{{nodes.<id>.output.outputs}}'.

fields.failOnErrorHint: Fail if the other flow fails

data_merge.title: Merge / Aggregate
data_merge.desc: Merge combines values from several nodes into one object. Aggregate sums, averages or collects a field from a list.

data_code.title: Code
data_code.desc: Runs JavaScript in an isolated sandbox. 'input.trigger' and 'input.nodes' hold the data. Return a JSON value.

app_slack.title: Slack: send message
app_slack.desc: Posts with a bot token (any channel) or an incoming webhook.

app_google_sheets.title: Google Sheets
app_google_sheets.desc: Appends a row or reads a range. Works with an OAuth token or a service account.

app_gmail.title: Gmail: send email
app_gmail.desc: Sends from the Gmail account connected in CRM by whoever created the flow (or the workspace owner).

app_stripe.title: Stripe
app_stripe.desc: Creates a customer or lists recent payments.

app_notion.title: Notion
app_notion.desc: Creates a page in a database or appends text to a page. Share the page or database with your integration first.

app_discord.title: Discord: send message
app_discord.desc: Posts to a channel through a webhook.

app_telegram.title: Telegram: send message
app_telegram.desc: Sends a message with your bot to a chat, group or channel.

ai_agent.title: Run agent
ai_agent.desc: Sends a message to one of your agents and returns its reply. Uses the agent's tools and knowledge.

fields.subject: Subject
fields.title: Title
fields.failOnErrorHint: Stop the flow when the robot run fails
fields.name: Name

runs.title: Runs
runs.empty: 0 runs yet. Use Test run or turn the flow on.
runs.selectRun: Select a run to see its steps.
runs.rerunOf: Re-run of {id}. Earlier steps reuse their previous output.
runs.rerunHint: Earlier steps reuse this run's output. Uses the saved flow.
runs.rerunDirty: You have unsaved changes. The re-run uses the last saved version. Continue?

errors.forbidden: Only workspace admins and owners can do this.
errors.conflict: Someone else saved this flow. Reload to see their changes.
errors.rate_limited: Too many runs for this workspace this hour. Try again later.
errors.invalid_graph: The flow has an invalid structure.
errors.graph_too_large: The flow is too large (max 100 nodes).
errors.duplicate_node: Two nodes have the same ID.
errors.no_trigger: Add a trigger: every flow starts with one.
errors.multiple_triggers: A flow can only have one trigger.
errors.unknown_edge_node: A connection points to a node that no longer exists.
errors.invalid_handle: A connection uses an output the node doesn't have.
errors.self_loop: A node can't connect to itself.
errors.cycle: Flows can't have cycles. Use a Loop node to repeat steps.
errors.delay_in_loop: Delay can't be used inside a Loop.
errors.invalid_timezone: Unknown time zone. Use a name like America/New_York.
errors.invalid_error_flow: Pick another flow of this workspace as the error flow.
errors.run_active: This run is still in progress.
errors.node_not_found: That node is no longer in the flow.
errors.node_is_trigger: Re-run from a step after the trigger.
errors.node_in_loop: Steps inside a Loop can't be re-run on their own. Re-run from the Loop.

onError.stopHint: The run fails here (after any retries).
onError.continueHint: The step is marked failed and the flow continues. Its output has 'error'.
onError.branchHint: Adds an Error output. Connect what should happen on failure.

versions.title: Versions
versions.subtitle: A version is saved every time the flow's nodes change.
versions.confirm: Restore version {n}? The current flow is kept as a version too.
versions.confirmDirty: Restore version {n}? Your unsaved changes will be lost.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.subtitle: API keys and tokens for Flow integrations and Robots. Encrypted at rest and never shown again after saving.
credentials.name: Name
credentials.nameHint: Letters, numbers, - and _. Robots use it as {example}.
credentials.confirmDelete: Delete {name}? Flows and robots that use it will fail.
credentials.emptyHint: Add one to use Slack, Google Sheets, Stripe, Notion, Discord or Telegram in your flows, or logins in Robots.
credentials.adminOnly: Only workspace admins and owners can add or edit credentials.
credentials.savedPlaceholder: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
credentials.keepHint: Leave empty to keep the saved value.
credentials.security: Values are encrypted with AES-256-GCM, are only decrypted while a run uses them and are redacted from run logs.

typeHints.api_key: Sent as a header in HTTP requests, for example Authorization: Bearer TOKEN.
typeHints.basic: HTTP basic auth, or a site login for Robots.
typeHints.oauth_token: Pasted access token, sent as Authorization: Bearer.
typeHints.slack: Bot token (xoxb-, needs chat:write) to post to any channel, or an incoming webhook URL.
typeHints.google: Access token with the Sheets scope, or a service account JSON key (share the sheet with its email).
typeHints.stripe: Secret or restricted key. Add the webhook signing secret to use the Stripe event trigger.
typeHints.notion: Internal integration token. Share pages or databases with the integration.
typeHints.discord: Channel webhook URL (Channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks).

errors.duplicate_name: A credential with this name already exists.
errors.invalid_json: The service account JSON is invalid (needs client_email and private_key).
